correctness.rationale: The r+2 column maps are exactly r identities, one capped successor g, and a zero reset. An m-digit column is nonconstant iff there is no reset and no more than d successors; choosing j successor positions gives precisely the claimed binomial D_m, including m=0. Constant columns are c0 through c_{m-1} before saturation and c0 through c_{d+1} afterward; injectivity of distinct column functions on the full-alphabet fixed sequence proves K_m and 2d+3 kernel size. Power g^{d+1} is constant, so on unequal-letter pairs discrepancy operator equals rI plus nilpotent upper-step transitions, spectral radius r. Primitive aperiodic height-one conditions checked, allowing the published Gröger–Krawczyk Theorems A/B to yield ac and null/tame equivalence. Independent explicit enumeration of 84 r,d,m cases (r=1..3,d=1..4,m=0..6) matched both D_m and K_m, not treated as proof of the all-parameter theorem.
